# Setup

```{r}
# Check current working directory
devtools::load_all(here::here())
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(corrplot)
library(rerddap)
library(ggplot2)
library(rerddap)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(rerddap)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(reticulate)
```

Next, we need to set up our python environment for reticulate and make sure it is calling the correct version of icechunk and arraylake to be able to interact with Eartmover. Reticulate automatically loads an environment when you start a new session and ensuring the python environment you are using with reticulate is correctly specifying the correct version of python and the Earthmover associated packages is key.

```{r}
# Force reticulate to pull down the newest package versions
#reticulate::py_install("dask")
py_require("icechunk>=2.0.0")
py_require("arraylake>=1.0.0")
py_require("zarr")
py_require("h5netcdf")
py_require("h5py")
py_require("xarray")
py_require("scipy")
py_require("dask")
# Import the fresh libraries
arraylake <- import("arraylake") #the data visual layer of Earthmover
zarr <- import("zarr") #interact with compressed data chunks and JSON metadata
xr   <- import("xarray") #python library for working with arrays
np   <- np <- import("numpy", convert = FALSE) #necessary for the NaN checking block
pd   <- import("pandas")
time <- import("time")
dask <- import("dask")

# Verify the version 
print(arraylake$`__version__`) 
```

Now we will load the data from Earthmover and a static .netcdf. Whether or not this loads correctly will identify whether the python environment is loaded correctly in R and may require trounblshooting


```{r echo=FALSE}

# 1. Load local NetCDF datasets using xarray
# depth is used to filter longitudinal extent based on isobath
ds_depth <- xr$open_dataset("../STATIC/ocean_static.deptho.nc")
# depth is used to filter longitudinal extent based on distance from shore
# 1. Open the raw file
ds_dist_raw <- xr$open_dataset("../STATIC/mom6-nep_regrid_dist2coast_CCS.nc")

# 2. Safely isolate the true geographic decimal vectors from the 2D matrix arrays
# Since they are stored as variables, we can extract the true linear coordinates
true_lat_vector <- py_to_r(ds_dist_raw[["lat"]]$values[, 1])
true_lon_vector_raw <- py_to_r(ds_dist_raw[["lon"]]$values[1, ])

# 3. Convert Longitude map from (-180 to 180) into (0 to 360) global scale
# This ensures that -125 degrees west maps to 235 degrees global
true_lon_vector <- (true_lon_vector_raw %% 360)

# 4. Wipe out the old placeholder data variables to prevent name collisions
ds_dist_clean <- ds_dist_raw$drop_vars(list("lat", "lon"))

# 5. Overwrite the generic index coordinates with your true geographical decimals
ds_dist_assigned <- ds_dist_clean$assign_coords(list(
  latitude = true_lat_vector,
  longitude = true_lon_vector
))

# 6. Standardize the dimension labels to match your main data exactly
ds_dist <- ds_dist_assigned$rename(list(latitude = "lat", longitude = "lon"))

# Verify the changes (You will see active asterisks * next to true decimal coordinates!)
print(ds_dist)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}

# 2. Connect to Earthmover Arraylake
client <- arraylake$Client()
repo <- client$get_repo("NOAA-PMEL/cefi-nep-hindcast-monthly")
session <- repo$readonly_session(branch = "main")

# Load aux group Zarr data - this is data that is not a direct main output (it is calculated from model output)
aux <- xr$open_zarr(session$store, zarr_format = 3L, group = "regrid/aux1")
# Load the main group Zarr data 
main <- xr$open_zarr(session$store, zarr_format = 3L, group = "regrid/main")
# Use list() to match Python's double bracket [['MLD_003']] dataset subsetting
ds_mld <- aux[list("MLD_003")]
ds_temp = main[list('thetao')]
ds_xv = main[list('uo_rotate')]
ds_yv = main[list('vo_rotate')]
ds_ssh = aux[list('ssh')]

```

```{r echo=FALSE}


climate_datasets <- data.frame(
  variable=c("NPGO", "PDO"),
  dataset_id=c( "cciea_OC_NPGO","cciea_OC_PDO") 
)

compiled_dataset<-NULL
for(i in 1:length(climate_datasets)){
    temp<-fetch_erddap_metric(dataset_id = climate_datasets$dataset_id[i], variable = climate_datasets$variable[i])
    # Fetch the raw data for the current row
    var_name <- climate_datasets$variable[i]
    # 3. Combine the data dynamically
    if (is.null(compiled_dataset)) {
      # First iteration: initialize the dataset with the first metric
      compiled_dataset <- temp
    } else {
      # Subsequent iterations: join side-by-side on the 'time' column
      compiled_dataset <- dplyr::full_join(compiled_dataset, temp, by = "time")
    }
    # Clean columns inside the loop so joining works seamlessly
    
}


compiled_dataset$month <- lubridate::month(compiled_dataset$time)
compiled_dataset$day   <- format(compiled_dataset$time, "%d")
compiled_dataset$year   <- lubridate::year(compiled_dataset$time)

cleaned_dataset<-compiled_dataset

# 3. Summarize metrics across each element of lifestage_dict dynamically
lifestage_summaries <- lapply(names(lifestage_dict), function(stage_name) {
  
  mn <- lifestage_dict[[stage_name]]$min_month
  mx <- lifestage_dict[[stage_name]]$max_month
  

    stage_data <- cleaned_dataset %>% filter(month >= mn & month <= mx)
 
  
  summary_stats <- stage_data %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        all_of(climate_datasets$variable), 
        ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
        .names = "{.col}"  # Creates: mean_NPGO, mean_PDO, etc.
      ),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(lifestage = stage_name)
  
  return(summary_stats)
}) %>% 
  bind_rows()

# 4. Reshape the dataset into a wide format grouped by Year
wide_lifestage_summary <- lifestage_summaries %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = lifestage,
    values_from = c(-year, -lifestage),
    # This reshapes names from "mean_NPGO" + "JA" into "mean_NPGO_JA"
    names_glue = "{.value}{lifestage}"
  )

# View your tidy, single-row-per-year database structure
print(head(wide_lifestage_summary))

# 5. Calculate lagged variables
lag<-1
preconditioning <-wide_lifestage_summary%>%
  mutate(year=year+lag)%>%
  select(c(year,contains("AS")))%>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "AS$", "_pre"), ends_with("AS"))

# 6. Full dataset
full_dataset <- left_join(preconditioning,wide_lifestage_summary)
write.csv(full_dataset, "Output/ERRDAP_var.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```



```{r echo=FALSE}
coast_points_filtered <- readRDS("../STATIC/coastal_angles.rds")

ASTeggs = transport_3d(ds_xv,ds_yv, ds_depth, coast_points_filtered, lifestage_dict, 'egg',precond=FALSE, TRUE)

ASTllarv = transport_3d(ds_xv,ds_yv, ds_depth, coast_points_filtered, lifestage_dict, 'larv',precond=FALSE, TRUE)

transport_3d <- function(u_dataset, v_dataset, long_dataset, coast_points_df, filter_dict, stage, precond, print_counts = TRUE) {
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  cat("--- Calculating 3D Coastal Transport (Alongshore & Cross-shore) ---\n")
  
  # Fetch native Python built-ins for slicing syntax
  py <- import_builtins()
  np <- import("numpy") 
  
  # =========================================================================
  # 1. TEMPORAL FILTERING
  # =========================================================================
  month_list <- seq(filter_dict[[stage]][["min_month"]], filter_dict[[stage]][["max_month"]])
  
  u_selected <- u_dataset[["uo_rotate"]]$sel(time = u_dataset$time$dt$month$isin(month_list))
  v_selected <- v_dataset[["vo_rotate"]]$sel(time = v_dataset$time$dt$month$isin(month_list))
  
  py_years <- u_selected$time$dt$year$values
  r_years <- py_to_r(py_years)
  
  # =========================================================================
  # 2. SPATIAL GEOGRAPHIC BOUNDARY SLICING
  # =========================================================================
  min_lat <- as.numeric(filter_dict[[stage]][["min_lat"]])
  max_lat <- as.numeric(filter_dict[[stage]][["max_lat"]])
  
  cat("Slicing spatial boundaries for U and V components...\n")
  u_selected <- u_selected$sel(lat = py$slice(min_lat, max_lat))
  v_selected <- v_selected$sel(lat = py$slice(min_lat, max_lat))
  
  # Detect the depth/vertical coordinate dimension name
  depth_name <- NULL
  available_dims <- py_to_r(py$list(u_selected$dims))
  for (d in c("depth", "lev", "plev", "vertical", "z_l")) {
    if (d %in% available_dims) {
      depth_name <- d
      break
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(depth_name) && "min_depth" %in% names(filter_dict[[stage]])) {
    min_depth <- as.numeric(filter_dict[[stage]][["min_depth"]])
    max_depth <- as.numeric(filter_dict[[stage]][["max_depth"]])
    cat(paste0("Slicing depth dimension (", depth_name, "): ", min_depth, " to ", max_depth, "\n"))
    
    depth_slice <- unname(list(py$slice(min_depth, max_depth))) |> setNames(depth_name)
    
    u_selected <- u_selected$sel(depth_slice)
    v_selected <- v_selected$sel(depth_slice)
  }
  
  # =========================================================================
  # 3. COORDINATE STANDARDIZATION & DATAFRAME ANGLE BROADCASTING
  # =========================================================================
  cat("Standardizing coordinate names and mapping dataframe angles...\n")
  dim_keys <- py_to_r(py$list(long_dataset$dims))
  rename_list <- list()
  if ("latitude" %in% dim_keys) rename_list$latitude <- "lat"
  if ("longitude" %in% dim_keys) rename_list$longitude <- "lon"
  if (!is.null(depth_name) && "deptho" %in% dim_keys) rename_list$deptho <- depth_name
  
  if (length(rename_list) > 0) {
    long_dataset <- long_dataset$rename(rename_list)
  }
  
  # Interpolate velocity matrices and masks onto matching grid structures
  v_array_aligned <- v_selected$interp_like(u_selected, method = "linear")
  mask_sliced     <- long_dataset[["deptho"]]$interp_like(u_selected, method = "nearest")
  
  # Extract the mean angle value from your calculated flat R dataframe
  # and broadcast it uniformly across the active 3D array matrix dimensions
  mean_angle_rad <- mean(coast_points_df$coast_angle_rad, na.rm = TRUE)
  cangle_sliced <- u_selected * 0 + mean_angle_rad
  
  # =========================================================================
  # 4. CROSS-SHORE MASK GENERATION
  # =========================================================================
  py_mask <- (mask_sliced$lat >= min_lat) & (mask_sliced$lat <= max_lat) & 
    (mask_sliced >= filter_dict[[stage]][['min_iso']]) & 
    (mask_sliced <= filter_dict[[stage]][['max_iso']]) & (!mask_sliced$isnull())
  
  # =========================================================================
  # 5. MATHEMATICAL ORIENTATION RESOLUTION (RADIAN EQUATIONS)
  # =========================================================================
  cat("Resolving vectors along high-res coastal orientation models...\n")
  ua_array <- v_array_aligned * np$sin(cangle_sliced) - u_selected * np$cos(cangle_sliced)
  uc_array <- v_array_aligned * np$cos(cangle_sliced) + u_selected * np$sin(cangle_sliced)
  
  ua_masked <- ua_array$where(py_mask)
  uc_masked <- uc_array$where(py_mask)
  
  # =========================================================================
  # 6. NATIVE DIMENSION COLLAPSING (XARRAY ENGINE)
  # =========================================================================
  all_dims <- py_to_r(py$list(ua_masked$dims))
  spatial_dims_to_drop <- all_dims[all_dims != "time"]
  
  cat("Collapsing spatial/vertical dimensions inside Python engine...\n")
  ua_series <- ua_masked$mean(dim = spatial_dims_to_drop, skipna = TRUE)
  uc_series <- uc_masked$mean(dim = spatial_dims_to_drop, skipna = TRUE)
  
  # =========================================================================
  # 7. PARSING DATA INTO R DATA FRAMES
  # =========================================================================
  cat("Extracting values free of memory overhead...\n")
  raw_ua <- py_to_r(ua_series$values)
  raw_uc <- py_to_r(uc_series$values)
  
  temp_df <- data.frame(
    year = r_years,
    u_along = raw_ua,
    u_cross = raw_uc
  )
  
  # =========================================================================
  # 8. R AGGREGATION & LAGGING WRAPPERS
  # =========================================================================
  cat("Aggregating annual timeline numbers in R...\n")
  ds_df_along <- aggregate(u_along ~ year, data = temp_df, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  ds_df_cross <- aggregate(u_cross ~ year, data = temp_df, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ds_df <- merge(ds_df_along, ds_df_cross, by = "year")
  
  if (precond) {
    cat("Applying 1-year environmental precondition lag (Years + 1)...\n")
    ds_df$year <- ds_df$year + 1
  }
  
  rownames(ds_df) <- ds_df$year
  ds_df$year <- NULL
  
  rm(temp_df, raw_ua, raw_uc, r_years)
  gc()
  
  end_time <- Sys.time()
  runtime_minutes <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
  cat(paste0("Runtime: ", round(runtime_minutes, 2), " minutes\n"))
  
  return(ds_df)
}
```
